Hi Kim —

I've drafted an offer packet for Sofia (SWE IC3, req 2026-0457) and uploaded the materials. Before I push the offer into the ATS I need final confirmation on the comp band and the approval routing we should use in the ATS. Can you confirm the following so I can move forward?

- Base salary target: $170,000 (we landed on midpoint during loop debrief) — approve or adjust?
- Equity grant: 0.25% vesting 4y, 1y cliff — ok?
- Sign-on: $10k one-time (approved by hiring manager verbally)
- Bonus: no sign-on bonus beyond $10k; standard eligibility for EOY discretionary bonus

Attached: SWE-IC3-Offer-Pack.docx, Comp-Band-IC3.csv (see comp band justification and manager note).

ATS question: do we route Offer creation to People Ops first (Monica) and then Legal/Finance, or do we route to Manager -> People Ops -> Finance? Our last couple of IC3s went Manager -> People Ops -> Finance, but I remember we tried People Ops-first on a different req for speed. Any preference here? Also, if we should change the approver list in ATS for this req (headcount approved under S-2026 Hires), let me know the approver emails/IDs to add.

Goal: have the candidate on an offer call tomorrow afternoon (Thu 26th). If I get thumbs up today I can create the offer in ATS and request approvals.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Attachment: SWE-IC3-Offer-Pack.docx (docx)
Attachment: Comp-Band-IC3.csv (csv)

- Click "Create Offer" -> select template "SWE-IC3-Standard"

- Under Approvals -> set approver sequence exactly as above; add manager approval first so we have timestamped manager sign-off in the audit log
- Add comment to offer: "Manager approved 2026-02-25 by Rohan Mehta (email captured)."

Please confirm when you create the offer so I can block Rohan and Monica for final reviews.

—Kim
